Not finished: argument drafted (finite coset average), elaboration of the final sum identities in `ℬ(L_w)` hung.

Shared notes for the averaging/Laurent issues of this file (#4274, #4276, #4281–#4284):
- Every local test function is locally constant with compact support (`mem_finitePlaceSchwartz_iff`), so it is invariant under an open subgroup V of the integer units. On the compact group U the average is then (μ(U)/|U/V|)·Σ over coset representatives of the dilates, which gives: the average is a Schwartz–Bruhat function (a finite combination of translates); `f − μ(U)⁻¹·avg f` lies in `Coinvariants.ker`, hence the kernel statement; and an invariant h satisfies avg h = μ(U)·h, hence surjectivity onto invariants.
- Continuity is automatic: `finitePlaceSchwartz_finestTopology` + `continuous_of_finestLocallyConvex`; for the inverse of the quotient map use `h ↦ mk (μ(U)⁻¹ • h)`.
- For the Laurent lemmas: every invariant h equals `h(0)·1_{π^N O} + Σ_{n∈[−M,N)} h(π^n)(1_{π^n O} − 1_{π^{n+1} O})` (M from compact support, N from local constancy at 0), and the ball indicators are independent since the coefficient of T^m is `Φp(π^m) − Φp(π^(m−1))`.
- These were all written out in Lean (https://github.com/ADB991/riemann-masullo/blob/rm-state/drafts/Ch06-Sec1-sweep-f988-draft.lean); the generic pieces (coset-average lemma, open stabilizer, finite-sum formula, Laurent spanning lemma) elaborate quickly. What stopped me was elaboration cost when these meet `ℬ(L_w)`: `obtain` on an `∃` over a linear map out of `ℬ(L_w)` never finishes (use `choose`); `rw` that leaves a goal about `ℬ` values can hang (use `rewrite` or explicit `Eq.trans`); local `have` instances (`T2Space`, `PolynormableSpace`) make `Add ℬ(L_w)` synthesis time out; and applying a continuity helper to a concrete linear map into `ℬ(L_w)` or bounded continuous functions hits a whnf timeout at the declaration. Plausibly instance terms for `ℬ(L_w)` reached by different paths, which forces unfolding `schwartzBruhatSubmodule`.
